CREDITS.title: Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1
CREDITS.name: Hanzi Writer Data
CREDITS.notice:
The stroke outlines and stroke-order lines for 6,854 characters are taken unmodified from chanind/hanzi-writer-data (https://github.com/chanind/hanzi-writer-data) version 2.0.1. That project converted them from the Make Me a Hanzi project, which extracted them from fonts made by Arphic Technology (Copyright (C) 1999 Arphic Technology Co., Ltd.). They are distributed under the Arphic Public License; the complete, unmodified license text is included at licenses/ARPHICPL.TXT.

The app only draws these outlines and animates the stroke order; pictures you export contain your own handwriting over a rendered reference image, not the outline data. Shizi adds no restriction to the rights the Arphic Public License gives you. The same stroke data, including the project's modified records below, is freely available under that license from the data/ folder of the public repository https://github.com/Eim-aa/shizi-open (each App release has a matching tag).

CREDITS.title: AnimCJK
CREDITS.name: AnimCJK
CREDITS.notice:
Stroke outlines and stroke-order lines for 363 further characters are derived from parsimonhi/animCJK (https://github.com/parsimonhi/animCJK) at commit ec5e17cca76c87587790bcbce5ea0b4d4fb753d6 (files graphicsZhHans.txt and graphicsJa.txt). AnimCJK's Chinese character graphics are based on the Arphic PL KaitiM fonts and are licensed under the Arphic Public License; the complete license text is included at licenses/ARPHICPL.TXT.

Modifications by the Shizi project: each record was converted to the Hanzi Writer format on 2026-07-29 by removing the source "character" key (outlines and stroke-order lines unchanged), and imported on 2026-08-05; for 豨 two stroke-order lines were exchanged (5 and 7), and for 镵 the three anchor points of stroke 13 were reordered. Every modified file states how and when it was changed in its own "_notice" field. The modified records are freely available under the Arphic Public License from the data/ folder of the public repository https://github.com/Eim-aa/shizi-open (each App release has a matching tag).

CREDITS.title: LXGW WenKai GB 1.522 (renamed ShiziKai)
CREDITS.name: LXGW WenKai GB
CREDITS.notice:
fonts/ShiziKai-Regular.woff2 is a Modified Version of LXGW WenKai GB (https://github.com/lxgw/LxgwWenkaiGB) version 1.522 (LXGWWenKaiGB-Regular.ttf, release tag commit 44cb0573002712c7d5c96f1b2aeea4420153f790, upstream SHA-256 295568c131648062107543aa159c97dd49564be791136c2abf74cad83eba3f7f). It was subset to the characters the app displays and renamed ShiziKai (all family, full, PostScript and typographic name records rebuilt), then compressed to WOFF2. The subset is used as a web font inside the app only and is not offered as an installable desktop font. It replaces the 4,264-byte LXGW WenKai 1.522 brand-glyph subset that the legacy (pre-v10) index.html embedded; the v10 shell no longer ships that subset.

Copyright 2022-2026 LXGW (https://github.com/lxgw/LxgwWenkaiGB) Copyright 2020 The Klee Project Authors (https://github.com/fontworks-fonts/Klee)

The font is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The complete, unmodified license text is included at licenses/LXGW-WenKai-GB-OFL.txt. The modifications and renaming are documented at licenses/Shizi-fonts-COPYRIGHT-NOTICES.md; the build inputs and scripts are in scripts/fonts/.

The stroke data for one character in the app, 𬇕, is also derived from the LXGW WenKai GB outline (converted into strokes and stroke-order lines by the Shizi project) and is provided under the same SIL Open Font License 1.1; it is not sold on its own.
